messages:
Maria (CS): FYI customer FinSec says their SIG/CAIQ is due Mon EOD and they need KMS/HSM audit logs + export proof.
Omar (Support): Which APIs are failing? any error codes?
Maria (CS): They hit the `/v1/exports/sig` endpoint and got intermittent 401s and a 500 yesterday. Customer sent snippets.
Jun (Solutions): Can you paste a minimal repro curl and the X-Request-Id from the failing call?
Maria (CS): Request id `req_20260301_7a9f`. Customer curl:

curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDWOOD..." -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/sig -d '{"scope":"kms","format":"caiq"}'

Omar (Support): Thanks. Any proxy or IP allowlist on their side? 401 usually token related.
Maria (CS): They said no. They swore token fresh. Attached server log snippet from our side:

[2026-03-01T11:02:13Z] WARN request=req_20260301_7a9f auth=failed reason="invalid token signature"
[2026-03-01T11:02:13Z] INFO request=req_20260301_7a9f route=/v1/exports/sig status=401 latency_ms=12
[2026-03-01T11:02:14Z] ERROR request=req_20260301_7a9f internal=key-fetch-failed err="HSM lookup timeout"

Priya (Security): That second error looks like an HSM/KMS backend timeout, could explain the 500s. We need HSM audit IDs and attestation to provide the CAIQ evidence.
Kevin (SRE): I'm seeing brief spikes in key-store latency around 11:02 UTC, aligns with those entries. Bucketed latency graph shows 95p jump to 3s.
Jun (Solutions): For repro: ask customer to run with `-H "X-Request-Id: <id>" -v` and capture full headers. Also include `curl --trace-ascii` output.
Omar (Support): I'll pull the internal key service traces for `req_20260301_7a9f` and share sanitized JSON.
Triage-Bot: Ticket #CS-91234 created and linked to this thread :ticket: (priority: high; SLA: 24h)
Maria (CS): Can we get an ETA to provide HSM attestation PDF + sanitized audit logs? Customer deadline is Monday EOD.
Priya (Security): I can produce attestation PDF but need HSM vendor confirmation (48h). For interim, we can provide signed audit log sample and key rotation policy.
Jun (Solutions): I can scrub PII and generate a sample export (no secrets) today. Will need sign-off from legal.
Kevin (SRE): I'll open an infra incident if we hit >2% request failures for key fetches in next 6h. For now rolling restart of one key-proxy pod to see if it clears transient HSM timeouts.
Maria (CS): Thanks all — please drop the artifacts here when ready. I'll request a 48h extension from the customer and push the interim samples.
Omar (Support): Uploaded sanitized trace to the ticket: `s3://internal-logs/cs-91234/req_20260301_7a9f.trace.gz`
Priya (Security): Added checklist: 1) HSM attestation (pdf) 2) KMS audit log sample (sanitized) 3) Key rotation policy doc 4) Evidence of export process. Will update ticket.
Jun (Solutions): On it — prepping log sample now :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): :eyes:
